  - number of connected components,
  - size of largest connected group,
  - compactness / spread,
  - bounding-box size,
  - local friendly adjacency,

  - principal-variation moves from the transposition table,
  - captures,
  - moves toward the center,
  - moves that increase local friendly support.

This gives a solid tactical player that is still fast enough to reliably return a legal move within the time limit.
